question: Which state ranked first in the Management Effectiveness Evaluation of national parks and protected areas 2020–2025 report?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Kerala tops the Management Effectiveness Evaluation of national parks and protected areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Kerala** ranked **first** in the **Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE) 2020–2025**, conducted by the **Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**.

 
 
• 
 
It was the **only state** to receive a **"Very Good" rating**, with a **score of 76.22%**.

 
 
• 
 
**Karnataka (74.24%)**, **Punjab (71.74%)**, and **Himachal Pradesh (71.36%)** received a **"Good" rating**.

 
 
• 
 
**Eravikulam National Park**, located in **Munnar, Kerala**, was ranked **best among all national parks in India**, scoring **92.97%**, **sharing the top rank with Dachigam National Park** in **Jammu & Kashmir**.

 
 
• 
 
The **MEE** was conducted across **438 Protected Areas**, based on **IUCN and WCPA global criteria**.

 
 
• 
 
**Eravikulam National Park** (97 sq.km) lies in the **Western Ghats’ shola-grassland ecosystem**.

 
 
• 
 
It hosts the **largest population of Nilgiri Tahr** (an **endangered** species).

 
 
• 
 
It's also famous for the **kurinji flowers (Strobilanthes kunthianus)**, which **bloom once every 12 years**.
